title: Rabbi Shimon ben Tachlifa
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Ketubot 111b](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.111b.14), saying: “Our father left us a stalk of cabbage, and we would go up and down it by a ladder.” But the Gra reads Rabbi Shimon ben Chalafta, and Hyman agrees with him, for so it is in [Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Peah.7.3.15).

notes.text: The Bavli names Shimon ben Tachlifa in the cabbage story, as does [Heilprin in his Tachlifa entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3489&lang=en). The Yerushalmi has Shimon ben Chalafta describing a mustard stalk that he climbed like a fig tree. Hyman endorses the Gra’s reading of the name.
